It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

Annual Turnover exceeds towards Man Power Supply Rs. 1.35 Crores per year, enclose the last two Financial Years 2023-24 and 2024-25, Certificate duly signed by Chartered Accountants with UDIN number
Balance Sheet copies for the Financial Year 2023-24 and 2024-25 duly certified by Chartered Accountant
Bidder Must should enclose Valid Company ISO 9001 2015 Registration Certificate
Certificate of Registration with ESI Authorities and FY 2025-26 Paid Chalans should be enclosed
Certificate of registration with Goods and Service Tax Department, GST and GSTR3B of September 2026 month OR 2nd Quarter of FY 2026-27 copy should be enclosed
Certificate of Registration with PF Authorities and FY 2025-26 paid Chalans should be enclosed
Certificate of Registration with Professional Tax Authorities and FY 2025-26 PT Monthly Returns in Form 5A Challans
Details of Bidder or Service Provider Name, Address, Contact Details
Income TAX Returns, ITR for the Financial Year 2023-24 and 2024-25 copies
